mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-quarter decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining GDP growth are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
